campaign: GCE CPP20 v7 frozen time models and judge-boundary experiment, 2026-11-19
decision: All three frozen policies failed qualification. No production clock or score policy was enabled.

environment.scope: One temporary guest reserved for the experiment. Physical host tenancy was unspecified.

software.integrity: Application-mutable counters in trusted diagnostic development fixtures.

protocol.collection: Within each case and round, each repetition ran one native execution, one complete diagnostic Durante execution and one native execution. Native controls were accepted with matched stdout. All terminal measurements used an unchanged installation and complete, uninterrupted counts with matched stdout and no unsupported REP entries. The minimum native duration applies to every native observation.
protocol.prediction: Take the ceiling after dividing the sum of coefficient times counter by ns_denominator. The baseline applies its REP coefficient to MOVS + STOS. Split policies apply separate positive coefficients. Signed error is predicted_ns minus the per-round case median of all six native CPU observations, with a half-nanosecond median rounded up.
protocol.gates_and_spread: Compute native and work spreads as (max - min)/median. Gate native CPU spread, instruction spread, total REP spread and, for split policies, both operation spreads. Compare absolute per-repetition error/native median exactly to the threshold. PPM displays round upward. A passing case satisfies all collection and per-repetition gates.
protocol.scope: Six fixed author-published programs, one input per program and three repeated executions. Repetitions, boundary pairs and policies measured on the same guest do not constitute independent programs.

cses_edit_distance.input_and_oracle: 5,000 uppercase characters are sampled from A–Y by the fixed LCG. Every 17th character becomes Z in the second string. Each edit can add at most one Z and substitutions achieve this bound.

cses_counting_rooms.input_and_oracle: A 1000 by 1000 wall grid separates the floor at each 29th row or 31st column; every maximal pair of remaining row/column bands is one component.

cses_factory_machines.input_and_oracle: 200000 machines comprise 50000 of each of four periods. Independent min-heap enumerates completion batches until target 999983721, then proves minimality by capacity at the preceding second.

gce_cses_towers.input_design: 200000 values from fixed 32-bit LCG seed 0x46932ce7; value = 1+((state>>10)%7000). Space-separated ASCII. Most current tower tops compete in data-dependent ordered-tree searches. Input length < 1MiB.
gce_cses_towers.output_oracle: Fenwick longest nondecreasing subsequence over cube sizes; reconstruct a witness subsequence for lower bound and partition into strictly decreasing rank classes for matching upper bound.

gce_cses_removal_game.input_design: 2600 signed values, in 1300 adjacent identical pairs. Base values from LCG seed 0x8ac3d91b, value=((state>>4)%2000001)-1000000. Covers diagonal DP access with two 2600x2600 64-bit matrices, roughly 104 MiB in the subject program.
gce_cses_removal_game.output_oracle: Optimal first player can guarantee one parity and both parities sum to the sum of one item from every identical pair; second player can guarantee a tie by immediately taking the just-exposed twin after every move. Exact value is half the total even with negative entries.

gce_cses_counting_divisors.input_design: 256 requests: first 8 numbers [1,2,36,64,83160,999983,997*997,1000000], then 248 terms limited to [1,1000000] using fixed LCG seed 0xfd28ab81 and 1+((state>>4)%1000000). The published solution constructs its full divisor sieve on all executions.
gce_cses_counting_divisors.output_oracle: For each query, multiply the successor exponents in its prime factorization. Independently cross-check by counting divisor pairs up to isqrt.

setup_attempt.failure: The sandbox could not execute the collector helper on its first invocation. Guest mount permissions were corrected before the full repeat.

split_rep_minimax.training_scope: All 45 built-in development triplets. The six external programs were excluded. Minimize maximum absolute relative prediction error, break ties by minimizing the maximum normalized feature exposures weighted by the coefficients, then quantize to integer numerators with denominator 1000000000.

component_order_lower_bound.argument: For A.min >= B.max in every counter, all nonnegative affine weights with any common intercept imply p_A >= p_B (also after common ceiling). For native times t_A < t_B the maximum relative error on the pair is at least (t_B - t_A)/(t_B + t_A). The conservative mode takes t_A=max six native A and t_B=min six native B. Case medians use the exact median of six controls, including half nanoseconds where present.
component_order_lower_bound.scope: Nonnegative affine functions of the three observed counters, with a common intercept, on these measured development cases.

online_clock_smoke.purpose: Exercise embedded and forwarded HTTP clock authority and watchdog attribution using synthetic coefficients.
online_clock_smoke.raw_watchdog_field: raw_watchdog_ms is the raw wall limit.

online_native_median_boundaries.thresholds: For exact median N nanoseconds of six native controls from split-gce, low = max(1, floor(4*N/5000000)) ms and high = ceil(6*N/5000000) ms. Median expectation is TLE at low and AC at high.

online_observed_native_boundaries.design: Three new ordinary native HTTP executions per unchanged program and cutoff. During measurement each request used the same compiled artifact and fixed CPU cutoff, 30000 ms wall limit and 256 MiB memory. Ordinary native execution had work measurement, normalization and short-case sampling disabled. Each array contains repetitions 1, 2 and 3, in order. Null records an omitted response field.
online_observed_native_boundaries.verification: Accepted responses completed with exit zero and the stdout verdict source. Native time-limit responses had the cpu_time verdict source. Every response had a positive CPU observation.
